data.name: TheManSkiesNoLimit!: Escape The Matrix
data.detailed_description:
The Journey Begins

The Man: Skies No Limit! is a story-driven 2D Pixel Art Action-Adventure RPG:

A mysterious being descends upon Earth, questioning humanity's worth before unleashing a corruption that spreads across the land, the seas, and the skies.

This chapter focuses on the skies.

Birds once free to soar now roam as corrupted beasts, while others have been transformed into deadly biomechanical weapons.

Far from the chaos lives Ebu, a naive, arrogant, boastful man whose greatest dream is to build a legacy of his own.

After a mysterious vision changes his life forever, he leaves behind everything he knows and sails toward the unknown.

A violent storm separates him from his wife.

Stranded in a foreign land, Ebu is rescued by Dr. Hermes, a scientist leading the resistance against the corruption.

Seeing potential in the young adventurer, Dr. Hermes entrusts him with his first weapon...

and his first chance to change the world.

Choose Your Path

Every journey begins with a choice.

Fight using Firearms or master the ancient art of the Bow.

Develop your own combat style through multiple weapon classes, upgrades, and specialized builds.

Whether you prefer overwhelming firepower or unmatched precision, every decision shapes the way you fight.

Purify the Skies

Battle corrupted wildlife, biomechanical birds, powerful bosses, and mysterious creatures born from both ancient curses and forgotten technology.

Explore unique regions, uncover hidden secrets, and survive increasingly dangerous encounters as the corruption continues to spread.

Awaken the Seven Chakras

Power alone is not enough.

Unlock the Seven Chakras to gain new abilities, strengthen your character, and discover powerful techniques throughout your adventure.

Each awakening represents another step toward understanding yourself.

Features:

  • Story-driven Action-Adventure RPG

  • Beautiful handcrafted 2D Pixel Art

  • Gun and Bow combat styles

  • Multiple weapon classes and builds

  • Weapon and character upgrades

  • Seven Chakra progression system

  • Epic boss battles

  • Corrupted and cybernetic enemies

  • Exploration, secrets, and hidden lore

  • Unique soundtrack

data.short_description: The Man: Skies No Limit! An Action-Adventure RPG. Meet Ebu, a naive, arrogant, boastful man who sets sail across a world consumed by corruption—not to save it, but to build his own legacy. As traps, trials, and twisted truths unfold, he'll discover the man he truly is.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
